entities.name: Sauromaces II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sauromaces II, of the Chosroid Dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Iberia from 361 to 363 and diarch from 370 to 378. He is ignored by the Georgian historic tradition, but mentioned by the 4th-century historian of the Roman Empire, Ammianus Marcellinus. He was the first son of Rev II and Salome and brother of Trdat of Iberia.
